QuestInfo.name: [Snowdrift Lodge] Make Way!
QuestInfo.0: Selina, the concierge at the Snowdrift Lodge, has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: Selina, the concierge at the Snowdrift Lodge, has a request for you. Snow piling up along the trail is endangering guests. Even though this is totally their job, you feel you should help out.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Selina, the Snowdrift Lodge concierge, with her request.

default.0: Our guests are saying that the path is still piled dangerously with snow! Our resident snowscaper is sick with the flu... Please, you have to do something.
